680.text: 680 * ardhāpūrta 'half-filled'. [ ardhá-², āpūrta -] Gaw. aḍā́waḍ 'half-full' Morgenstierne NOGaw 27.

13471.html:
13471 sudhā f. 'nectar' MBh., 'juice, milk' VarBr̥S., 'whitewash, plaster, mortar' MBh., 'brick' lex.
    Pa. sudhā- f. 'nectar, limewash, lime', Pk. sudhā-, chuhā- f.; S. chuhā-pāṇī m. 'curds and whey'; OG. choha 'lime plaster', G. cho, choī f. (whence chovũ 'to plaster').
